system.description:
You have stolen information, and methods to combat and survive hostile environments from cautious hidden Sand shinobi that speak highly of their techniques.

When you cast a Genwa Hijutsu, select a point that you can see within 30 feet of you. You generate a 20-foot radius of protection, granting all creatures within the given area a rank of mastery to checks or saves made to resist hostile environments, or jutsu based effects that affect an area.

At the beginning of each of your turns, while concentrating on a jutsu with the lightning release keyword, you gain bonus DR, equal to your highest ability modifier against the first instance of damage you take before the beginning of your next turn. If you are concentrating on two or more jutsu with the lightning release keyword, you instead gain bonus DR equal to twice your highest ability modifier.

When you cast a jutsu that affects an area and can be concentrated on, you can give the chosen jutsu the Sensory keyword. When you do, for the jutsu’s duration, you gain Tremor sense in the affected area.
